summary: Ran the report on every commit between v2.3.0 and v2.4.0; the first commit giving the 2.4.0 totals is 9a04783 (its parent gives the 2.3.0 totals). The cause is the parse_stamp change in tally/dates.py, which converts offset timestamps to UTC before the date is taken. The earliest tag containing it is v2.4.0rc1.
